title: Theory that nuclear fuels were used to alter gravity and time on nuclear bases

tellings.quote: nuclear fuels were used mid-century to alter gravity we know that gravity and time are linked in general relativity

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, puts forward the idea that in the 1950s nuclear fuels were used at US nuclear bases to alter gravity. He notes that in general relativity, Einstein's theory of gravity, gravity and time are linked, so time might have been changed too, and he connects the idea to Dark, a time-travel series on Netflix. If true, it would explain why strange things gather around nuclear sites.
